text: Tomb of Bibi Jawindi Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Tomb of Bibi Jawindi Type: Monument - Tomb Province: Punjab District: Bahawalpur Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1206 - 1526 CE Description: A tomb, octagonal in plan, built on some few meters high mound in brick faced with glazed tiles. The sides have round tapered turrets surmounted with round pillars of the same style. Each octagon has an oblong framing with a border of glazed tiles and within this frame is an arched opening, recessed in three stages and faced with glazed brick-tiles. The floral design is composed of brick tiles of triangular shape. The south-west octagon had a flight of steps leading to the second storey. Similarly, the interior of the tomb has arched recess in three stages the soffits of which are covered with glazed tiles.
